title: Tiny, cute bell
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFA500'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bellGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE44D'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E6A800'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Bell body -->
  <path d='M50 22 Q30 24 26 50 Q22 68 20 74 Q22 78 30 80 L70 80 Q78 78 80 74 Q78 68 74 50 Q70 24 50 22 Z' fill='url(#bellGrad)' stroke='#FFAA00' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Bell shine -->
  <path d='M40 28 Q34 30 32 48 Q30 58 31 64' fill='none' stroke='#FFF6B0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Bell rim bottom -->
  <rect x='18' y='76' width='64' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#E6A800' stroke='#FFAA00' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Bell top loop -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- Clapper -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='88' r='5' fill='#FFB347' stroke='#FFE44D' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <circle cx='42' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#5C3A00'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#5C3A00'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='49' r='1.2' fill='#FFF6B0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='49' r='1.2' fill='#FFF6B0'/>
  <!-- Cute smile -->
  <path d='M44 60 Q50 66 56 60' fill='none' stroke='#5C3A00' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='57' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='57' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <path d='M18 32 L20 28 L22 32 L20 36 Z' fill='#FFF6B0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M80 38 L82 34 L84 38 L82 42 Z' fill='#FFF6B0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='26' r='1.8' fill='#FFF6B0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6B0' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
